Moving A right to R2C4 so B can move into R2C3. I can continue east a step or two if B needs to pass, then loop back west to R2C1 once R2C2/R2C3 are free. D is holding at R8C1; I'll move it up next to open R8C1 for C. F will head left via R7C5/R7C4/R6C4/R6C3/R6C2 to R8C2, freeing R7C6 for E.

Moving B to R2C3, ready to follow through R2C4 once you shift A east of R2C7. I'll need R2C5-R2C7 clear briefly; then B can head to R4C6. For C, please move D past R7C1 (R6C1 is fine) and get F off R7C6; C will use the R7C6 bridge and enter R8C1 via R7C1. E will wait until C crosses, then tuck into R7C6.

Moving F left to R7C5 now, so R7C6 is free for C’s bridge. F will continue along R7C5->R7C4->R6C4->R6C3->R6C2->R7C2->R8C2, clearing the route C needs. A will then shift east to R2C8 to clear R2C4-R2C7 for B, then return to R2C1. D will move up to R6C1 over the next turns to open R8C1. E can take R7C6 after C crosses.

Moving C right to R1C7 to wait; it won't block A shifting east along row 2. I'll keep B out of R2C7 until A is past it, then B will follow C through R2C7-R3C7-R4C7; C will pass R4C6 before B takes it. Please keep F off R7C4-R7C6 and move D up from R8C1 so C can finish via R7C1. E will stage at R8C6 but won't take R7C6 until C crosses.

Moving A right to (R2,C5) to open R2C4 for B; I'll continue A east to R2C8 so row 2 is clear for B/C. Then F will pass through R7C4 and immediately up to R6C4, clearing R7C5/R7C4 for C. D will move up from R8C1 soon to free R7C1/R8C1. E can stage at R8C6.

Moving B right to (R2,C4), following A east. I’ll keep B out of (R2,C7) until C has used (R2,C7)-(R3,C7)-(R4,C7) and (R4,C6), then B will tail C to (R4,C6). C stays at (R1,C7) until A is clear at (R2,C8). Please move F past (R6,C4) to (R5,C4) so C can get through (R7,C4)/(R6,C4), and move D from (R8,C1) to (R7,C2) to clear C’s finish. E will stage at (R8,C6) later.

Moving A right to (R2,C6), continuing east to (R2,C8) so C can use (R2,C7) after I clear it. After A is clear, I'll start F left to (R7,C4)->(R6,C4)->(R5,C4) and D up/right to (R7,C2). I won't block (R2,C7) longer than needed; C can wait until I reach (R2,C8).

Moving B right to (R2,C5), following A east but staying out of (R2,C7)/(R3,C7)/(R4,C7) until C has cleared them. Once A reaches (R2,C8), C can move down. I’ll tail C through (R4,C6) without blocking it. Please keep F moving to (R5,C4) and D to (R7,C2); E can wait until C is past (R7,C6).

Moving A right to R2C7 now. I know C is waiting at R1C7 to come down; I’ll clear R2C7 next turn by moving A to R2C8. B can take R2C6 once I leave it, but please keep B out of R2C7 until C has passed. I’ll keep F and D staged as planned and won’t block your path through R4C6/R7C6.

Moving B right to R2C6, as planned. R2C7 stays open for A to step to R2C8, then C can move down. I’ll keep B out of R2C7/R3C7/R4C7 until C has cleared them, and won’t block C through R4C6. Please clear R7C5/R7C6 for C’s lower route and move the X at R8C1 so C can finish. E will wait until C is past R7C6.

Moving A right to R2C8, freeing R2C7 for C to move down. After C leaves R1C7, I'll take A via row1 to R2C1, so B can keep R2C6. Next I'll move F left from R7C5 to R7C4 to clear R7C5/R7C6 for C's lower route. I'll also move D out of R8C1 before C gets there. Please keep C moving and let me know when you need these cells.

Moving C down to R2C7; R1C7 is free for A's row1 route. I found a shorter route for C: R4C6-R5C6-R5C5-R5C4-R6C4-R6C3-R6C2-R6C1-R7C1-R8C1, so R7C5/R7C6 don't need clearing for C. If F goes to R7C4, keep it off R6C4 until C passes, or move it out via R5C4/R5C3 first. Please move D to R8C2, not R7C1. B will wait at R2C6 until C clears R4C6; E will go to R7C6 without blocking.

Moving D right to R8C2 to clear R8C1 as you asked. I'll keep D off R7C1 and route it to R8C7 only after C clears the lower corridor. A will go up to R1C8 next and use row1 to R2C1. F will wait at R7C4 and avoid R6C4/R5C4 until C has passed. Let me know when the lower route is clear.

I’m moving C down to (R3,C7) to start the corridor route. C will continue via (R4,C7), (R4,C6), (R5,C6), (R5,C5), (R5,C4), (R6,C4), (R6,C3), (R6,C2), (R6,C1), (R7,C1), then to (R8,C1). B waits at (R2,C6) until C clears (R4,C6), then follows to (R4,C6). E will move left to (R8,C6) then up to (R7,C6), freeing (R8,C7) for D. Please keep F off (R6,C4)/(R5,C4) until C passes.

Moving A up to R1C8, then across row1 to R1C5, down to R2C5, left to target R2C1. D stays on R8C2 until C passes through R6C4/R6C3/R6C2/R6C1/R7C1/R8C1; I’ll keep D off R7C1. F remains at R7C5, avoiding R6C4/R5C4 until C clears. Tell me when the lower route is clear and I’ll route D to R8C7.

Moving C down to R4C7, then C will pass R4C6, R5C6, R5C5, R5C4, R6C4, etc. B waits at R2C6 until R4C6 clears, then moves there. E will shift to R8C6 then R7C6, freeing R8C7 for D. Please keep F off R5C4/R6C4 until C passes; A seems clear for R2C1.

Moving F left to R7C4 to free R7C5 and stage for later; F stays off R6C4/R5C4 until C clears. D holds at R8C2; I won’t send D into R6C2 until C passes. A can start left afterward; B’s route to R4C6 via the upper right won’t conflict with A along row1. Please keep R7C6/R6C6 clear when D needs them.

Moving C left to R4C6 as planned; it will head down through R5C6, R5C5, R5C4, R6C4, R6C3, R6C2, then to R8C1. This frees R4C7 for B and clears R6C2 before D needs it. B waits at R2C6 and uses the upper right once R4C6 is free. E stays at R8C7 for now so R6C6/R7C6 remain clear for D; I’ll move E after D passes. Please keep F off R5C4/R6C4 until C clears.

I’m moving A left along row1 to start its path to R2C1; this avoids the right-side corridor you need for B. D will stay at R8C2 until C clears R7C2, then D can head toward R8C7. F remains at R7C4, keeping off R6C4/R5C4 as you asked. Please have E clear R8C7 before D arrives.

Moving C down to R5C6 as planned; this frees R4C6 for B. Keeping E at R8C7 for now so R7C6/R8C6 stay open. Heads-up: E’s only exit from R8C7 is to R8C6, and its target R7C6 blocks the R7C6→R8C6 path. If D truly needs R8C7, we must resolve that conflict before I move E; otherwise D won’t be able to pass. Please keep F off R5C4/R6C4 until C clears.

I'm moving A left along row1 toward R2C1, staying clear of your B at R2C6 and the right-side routes. I'll keep F at R7C4 and avoid R5C4/R6C4 until C clears. D still needs R8C7; if E's exit to R7C6 blocks that corridor, D may need to go via R5C6/R4C6/right side, so please let me know when C is clear and whether D can pass through those cells. A's move shouldn't create obstacles for you.

C down to R6C6 clears R5C6 for D; use R5C6 -> R4C6 -> R4C7 -> R4C8 -> right side to reach R8C7. R6C6 is occupied, so avoid that corridor. E stays at R8C7 for now, keeping R8C6/R7C6 open until you are past. B will wait above R4C8 until D clears the right-side route, then B can take R4C6. F should keep clear of R5C4/R6C4 while C later returns via R5C6.

Moving D up to R7C2 first to start D’s long route and free R8C2 for F later. I’ll take D via R5C2/R5C3/R5C4/R5C5/R5C6, then up to R4C6/R4C7/R4C8 and down the right side. I’ll keep F at R7C4 and clear of R5C4/R6C4 until C is done. A will wait at R1C6 so it won’t block B. Please keep E at R8C7 until D reaches R8C8; then move E to R8C6 so D can finish at R8C7.

I’m sliding B right to R2C7, then I’ll wait at R3C8 so D can use R4C6→R4C7→R4C8→R5C8 without me blocking. C stays at R6C6 until D clears R5C6, then I’ll route C through R5C6/R5C5/R5C4/R6C4 toward R8C1. E will remain at R8C7 until D reaches R8C8; then I’ll move E to R8C6 and later R7C6. Tell me if D needs extra space.

Moving D up to R6C2 as planned; R7C2 is now free for F’s eventual run through R6C4/R6C3/R6C2/R7C2 to R8C2. F stays at R7C4 so C can use R5C4/R6C4 later. A remains at R1C6 for now; I’ll start it toward R2C1 once B is settled at R3C8. Hope E can hold R8C7 until D reaches R8C8.

Moving B down to R3C7 now; next turn I’ll put it at R3C8 so D has R4C6→R4C7→R4C8→R5C8 clear. C stays at R6C6 until D clears R5C6. E holds R8C7 until D reaches R8C8. Let me know if D needs that corridor sooner or if you need a different spacing.

Moving D up to (R5,C2), freeing (R6,C2) for F. D will go (R5,C3)->(R5,C4)->(R5,C5)->(R5,C6), then up to (R4,C6) and along the right corridor to (R8,C8), then into (R8,C7). B at (R3,C8) next works; C at (R6,C6) until (R5,C6) clears is fine. E can shift to (R8,C6) when D reaches (R8,C8). F stays at (R7,C4) for now.

Moving B right to R3C8 as planned, so D’s path R4C6→R4C7→R4C8→R5C8 stays open. C stays at R6C6 until D clears R5C6; E remains at R8C7 until D reaches R8C8, then shifts to R8C6. I’ll keep B out of R4C6 until D has passed through it.

Moving D right to (R5,C3), continuing along row5 to (R5,C6) then up to the right corridor. C can stay at (R6,C6) until I pass (R5,C6). Please keep B clear of the right corridor while D travels. E, when D reaches (R8,C8), please shift to (R8,C6) so I can finish at (R8,C7). F and A will start their routes soon.

E is moving left to R8C6 now, so R8C7 is clear for D’s finish. C stays at R6C6 until D clears R5C6. B will keep clear of R4C6–R4C8 and R5C8 until D has passed, then head to R4C6. Let me know if F or A need R8C6 or R7C6 before E settles.

D moves right to R5C4, continuing along R5 to C6 then up through R4C6–R4C8 and down C8. Please keep B out of R4C6–R4C8 and R5C8 until D passes. E at R8C6 works; R8C7 will be approached from R8C8. F will head via R6C4/R6C3/R6C2 to R8C2, avoiding your area. A will later go left along R1/R2 to R2C1.

Moving E up to R7C6, its goal, so R8C6 is now clear. B stays at R3C8 until D clears R4C6–R4C8 and R5C8; C holds at R6C6 until D leaves R5C6, then C goes up/left toward R8C1. Let me know when D has passed R4C6 so B can move down. F/A paths don't seem to need R7C6/R8C6, but say if they do.

I'm moving D right to R5C5. Next: R5C6, then R4C6-R4C8 and down C8 to R8C7. Please keep B at R3C8 until D clears R4C6/R4C8/R5C8. C can take R5C6 after I leave it. F will head up through R6C4/R6C3/R6C2 to R8C2; A later will drop to R2 and move left to R2C1. Does that conflict with C? Let me know.

Moving B left to R3C7 to get closer to R4C6 while keeping D's route through R5C6/R4C6-R4C8/R5C8 clear. C stays at R6C6 until D vacates R5C6, then will head left toward R8C1. E is already at R7C6 and stays. F/A paths don't seem affected; let me know if R3C7 or R5C6 timing needs adjusting.

Moving D right to R5C6 as planned. Next D goes to R4C6, then R4C7-R4C8 and down C8 to R8C7. Please keep R4C7/R4C8/R5C8 clear until D passes. Once D leaves R5C6, C can move up into it and head left. B at R3C7 doesn't block my route. A will head down to R2C6 then left to R2C1; F will go up via R6C4/R6C3/R6C2 to R8C2. Let me know if any timing conflict.

B will sidestep to R3C8 to wait, keeping R4C6-R4C8 and C8 clear for D. C is stuck at R6C6 until D leaves R5C6; once that opens, I'll move C up and head left toward R8C1. E is already home. My B detour shouldn't affect A/F paths; let me know if R3C8 needs to be free.

Moving D up to R4C6, freeing R5C6 for C now. D will continue R4C7/R4C8 then down C8 to R8C7; please keep R4C7/R4C8/R5C8 clear. A will go down to R2C6 then left; F via R6C4/R6C3/R6C2. No overlap with your C route.

Moving C up from R6C6 to R5C6 now that D freed it. I'll take C left along row5 to R8C1, staying clear of your D column-8 route. E is home. B remains at R3C8 as a wait; I won't enter R4C7/R4C8/R5C8 until D has passed. B still needs R4C6 eventually, so I'll move in once you vacate it. Does R3C8 block anything? Tell me if you need it.

Moving D right to R4C7, freeing R4C6 for B once D clears R4C8. B’s R3C8 does not block A or F; A will use row2, F uses R6C4/R6C3/R6C2/R7C2/R8C2. Please keep R4C8 and R5C8 clear for D’s column-8 route. C can stay left on row5/C1 route with no overlap.

Moving C left to R5C5, continuing along row5 toward C1 then down to R8C1. I’ll keep clear of R4C8/R5C8 for D. B stays at R3C8 until D clears R4C7/R4C8; B needs R4C6 eventually, so I’ll move in once you vacate it. E is home. Tell me if R3C8 blocks anything.

Moving D right to R4C8; next D down to R5C8, then column8 to R8C7. That clears R4C7 now and R4C8 next turn for B’s path to R4C6. I expect C continues along row5 toward C1; no overlap with A (row2) or F (R6C4/R6C3/R6C2/R7C2/R8C2). Tell me if R3C8 needs to move before D clears.

Moving B left to R3C7 now, then down to R4C7 and right to R4C6. This avoids R4C8, so D can move down column8 freely. R3C8 is now free if you need it. C will continue left along row5 after B is moving; I’ll keep clear of R4C8/R5C8. E stays home. Let me know if R4C7 conflicts with D’s route.

D down to R5C8 as planned, freeing R4C8. R4C7 is yours for B; D stays in column8 and won't need it. C can keep moving left along row5—D at R5C8 is past the wall at R5C7, so no overlap. After D clears, F will go up and across R6 to R8C2. Let me know if B needs anything around R4C6.

Moving B down to R4C7 as planned; next turn right to R4C6. R4C8 and column8 stay clear for D. C will keep left along row5 toward R8C1, so it won't block F moving up/across row6. E remains at R7C6. R4C6 is free for B; let me know if F needs R6C2 or R6C1 before C gets to R8C1.

Moving F up to R6C4 to start its path to R8C2 via R6C3-R6C1-R7C1-R7C2. F needs R6C1 and R7C1 before C gets down from R5C1; please hold C at R5C1 for a couple turns if needed. D will continue down column8, so keep R6C8-R8C8 clear. A is heading down/left to R2C1; no conflict with B at R4C6.

Moving B left into R4C6, its target. C will keep moving left along row5 and wait at R5C1 until F has used R6C1 and R7C1 before descending, so F stays clear. E remains at R7C6. Column8 remains open for D. Let me know if timing needs adjustment.

Moving F left to R6C3, then continuing toward R8C2 via R6C2/R6C1/R7C1/R7C2. Please keep C at R5C1 until F has cleared R6C1 and R7C1. D will move down column8 once clear; keep R6C8–R8C8 open. A will head down to row2 shortly, no conflict with B at R4C6.

Moving C left toward R5C1, where I'll hold until F has cleared R6C1 and R7C1. B and E are already on their targets. No conflict with F at R6C3 moving left. Let me know when the lower-left path is clear.

F left to R6C2 as planned. I’ll clear R6C1 then R7C1, so hold C at R5C1 until I leave R7C1. After that, C can move down through R6C1/R7C1. D will head down column8 afterward; A goes along row2 to R2C1. No conflict with your B/E.

Moving C left toward R5C1 to hold as agreed. B and E are already on their targets. I see F heading to R6C1 then R7C1; I won’t enter that lower-left path until you’ve cleared R7C1. Let me know when it’s safe for C to descend to R8C1.

Correction: F can go straight down to R8C2 via R7C2, so R6C1 and R7C1 are already clear for C. I’m moving F down to R7C2 now; once C reaches R5C1 it can descend to R8C1. D will head down column8, and A will move along row2. No obstacles for your B/E.

Moving C left to R5C2, then down via R5C1 -> R6C1 -> R7C1 -> R8C1. B and E remain on targets. I see F at R7C2 heading toward R8C2; C only needs R7C1, so our paths won’t block each other. D down column 8 and A along row 2 don’t affect my route. Let me know if you need R5C1 or R6C1 before I pass through.

F is one step from its target; moving it down to R8C2 now. This frees R7C2 and keeps C’s corridor R5C1→R6C1→R7C1→R8C1 clear. Next I’ll take A down to row2 and head left toward R2C1, while D moves down column8 toward R8C7. No conflicts with your B/E from my path.

C is at R5C2, moving left to R5C1, then down via R6C1, R7C1, R8C1. B and E are already on their targets, so I won’t move them. I see F now at R8C2; my route stays in column 1, so no conflict. D down column 8 and A along row 2 should be unaffected. Let me know if you need R5C1 or R6C1 before C passes through.

F is already placed at R8C2. I’m moving A down from R1C6 to R2C6, then I’ll head left along row 2 to R2C1. This stays above the R3 wall and won’t interfere with C’s column 1 route. D will follow down column 8 toward R8C7, clear of your objects. Let me know if you need anything from row 2 before I settle A there.

C is at R5C1 and I’m moving it down to R6C1, then continuing to R8C1. B and E are already placed. Your A route along row 2 and D down column 8 stay clear of my column 1 path. Let me know if you need anything adjusted.

I'm moving A left from R2C6 to R2C5, continuing toward R2C1. Your C route down column 1 stays clear—the R3 wall separates it from my row 2 path. D is still waiting at R5C8; I'll send it down column 8 to R8C7 in the next moves, so it won't interfere with your objects. Let me know if you need any row 2 space before I settle A.

C is at R6C1, moving down to R7C1, then to R8C1 next turn. B and E are already placed. Your A along row 2 and D down column 8 remain clear of my column 1 path; I won’t need R8C2. Let me know if you need any space in column 1 before I settle.

I'm moving A left from R2C5 to R2C4, continuing toward R2C1. Your C at R7C1 heading to R8C1 looks clear; my F is already at R8C2 and won't block. D will move down column 8 to R8C7 afterward, so it won't cross your column 1 path. Let me know if you need row 2 space before I finish.

Moving C down from R7C1 to R8C1 to place it. B and E are already at their targets, so after this move all my objects are placed. Your A heading along row 2 to R2C1 stays clear of my column 1 path. I also won’t interfere with D moving down column 8. Let me know if you need any space around R8C1 or R7C1 before I finish.

Moving A left to (R2,C3), continuing to (R2,C1). F is already at target (R8,C2). D will move down column 8 to (R8,C7), so I won't cross your placed objects at column 1 or row 7/8 area. Since all your objects seem placed, I'll avoid disturbing them.

D needs to travel down column 8 then left to (R8,C7). I’m moving D down to (R6,C8) first. A will move from (R2,C3) to (R2,C1) next, and F is already at (R8,C2). You’re done, so I’ll continue alone without disturbing your placed objects.

Teammate done, I’ll continue alone. I’m moving D down from R6C8 toward R8C7; next it will go to R8C8 then left. After that I’ll shift A left from R2C3 to R2C2 and finally R2C1. F stays placed at R8C2. No conflict with your finished objects.

Thanks! I’m moving D down from (R7,C8) to (R8,C8), then left to its target (R8,C7). After that I’ll shift A left from (R2,C3) to (R2,C2) and finally to (R2,C1). F is already placed at (R8,C2). I won’t touch your X objects.
Teammate done noted. I’ll move D left to its target (R8,C7) now, then shift A left twice from (R2,C3) to (R2,C1). F is already placed at (R8,C2). No interference with your X objects.
Thanks! D and F are already on target. I’m moving A left from (R2,C3) to (R2,C2), then next turn to (R2,C1). No conflict with your objects.
Thanks! D and F are already on target. Moving A left from (R2,C2) to (R2,C1) to complete my placement. No conflict with walls or objects. Later I'll declare done.
